pll2d16c2-d1e3519.summary: States that it remains to discuss what and how man was made.

pll2d16c2-d1e3522.summary: Reads Gen 1:26: 'let us make' shows one operation of the three persons; 'our image and likeness' one equal substance of the three. It is said by the Father to the Son and Spirit, not, as some think, to angels, since God and angels do not share one image or likeness.
claims: The three persons share one operation and substance.
God did not speak to angels in Gen 1:26.

pl-l2d16c2.summary: Begins treating what and how man was made. In 'let us make man in our image and likeness,' 'let us make' shows one operation of the three persons, and 'our image and likeness' one equal substance of the three. It is said by the Father to the Son and Spirit, not to angels, since God and angels do not share one image.
claims: 'Let us make' shows one operation of the three persons.
'Our image and likeness' shows one equal substance of the three persons.
God spoke to the Son and Spirit, not to angels.
